biotools.summary: BenchAMRking is a Galaxy-based platform designed to illustrate the discrepancies encountered when predicting antimicrobial resistance genes from microbial whole genome sequencing data. The platform facilitates comparison of different AMR gene prediction workflows by providing a standardized interface and validated workflows.
